string.text: Per-squad combat memory and behaviors. The substrate accumulates hits and exposes squad state; hit disclosure forces the entire squad to react when any member is hit, even those out of audio range. Master toggle below disables the whole feature (no hooks, no ticks).

How long a per-shooter entry stays in the squad's combat memory after the last hit from that shooter. Lower = squads forget snipers quickly. Higher = sustained pressure keeps disclosed shooters in memory. Multiplied 5x automatically while the squad is ALERTED or ENGAGED (memory persistence layer). Default: 60.

How many combat events (hits, sightings) within the event window before an ALERTED squad escalates to ENGAGED. A single disclosure event always short-circuits straight to ENGAGED regardless of count. Default: 3.
Rolling window over which combat events are counted toward the ENGAGED threshold. Older events drop off. Default: 60.
How long an ENGAGED squad stays engaged without new events before demoting to ALERTED. The de-escalation tick runs every 5 seconds so actual demotion may lag by up to that interval. Default: 60.
How long an ALERTED squad stays alerted without new events before demoting to IDLE. Default: 120.
Per-stalker healing behaviors. Each section below tunes one subsystem.

Vanilla xr_eat_medkit's [plugin] section ships without the medkits / bandages item lists, so the consumption loop iterates over nothing and stalkers never use the kits in their inventory. AlifeTactics restores the missing lists through a DLTX overlay on ai_tweaks/xr_eat_medkit.ltx covering the vanilla medkits and the bandage. Data-layer fix loaded at boot; no runtime toggle.

Multiplies the per-tick HP recovery in xr_eat_medkit's heal_hp loop. Vanilla restores 0.05 HP per tick for 13 ticks (0.65 HP total) before the heal cycle exits. At 2.0x each tick restores 0.10 HP, so the heal completes in fewer ticks. At 0.5x each tick restores 0.025 HP. Default: 1.0.

Probability that a novice-rank stalker is granted the lifetime healing_charge token at first spawn. The charge fires once if the stalker drops below the medkit_health threshold without a medkit in inventory. Vanilla rolls 50% for every rank. Default: 50.
Debug and development tools. DEBUG enables structured tracing of substrate writes, state transitions, and disclosure events. Written to alifetactics.log. Has performance cost.
Controls log verbosity. ERROR: crashes only. WARN: anomalies. INFO: substrate lifecycle and state transitions. DEBUG: full tracing per squad event.

Stalkers in vanilla fire with one shared dispersion - the engine's rank curve is dead at Anomaly's rank values. AlifeTactics restores per-rank scaling so masters shoot tighter than novices. Tune each tier below.
Dispersion for novice-rank stalkers. Lower = tighter shot cone = more lethal. 1.00 matches vanilla engine baseline. Default: 1.00.
Dispersion for legend-rank stalkers (max tier). Default: 0.38.
Master toggle for the whole Squad Memory feature: substrate, state machine, and hit disclosure. When off, no callbacks fire, no decay ticks run, no per-squad records exist. Default: on.

Master toggle for the whole Stalker Healing feature: heal rate patch and per-rank healing-charge override. When off, vanilla xr_eat_medkit behavior runs unmodified. Toggle requires game restart. The medkit DLTX overlay is boot-time and always active. Default: on.
Master toggle for the per-shot accuracy hook. When off, the engine's default (flat) dispersion applies to every stalker regardless of rank. Default: on.
